mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 320, it indicates elevated inflation, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL > 320, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5% and employment (PAYEMS) falls below 158,000 thousand persons, it indicates a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE > 4.5 and PAYEMS < 158000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 320), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 320, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
